items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: My idea with Columbia Records was not how much money... So what I did ask Mr. Sachs for was the same amount of exploitation, publicity and press...

ctx.x: Very. And, of course, I was there during a period which was not a long one, where a guy -- Manny Sachs, who was Sinatra's man, and he liked music and he had a flare for putting good things together. And very few suggestions, other than, 'Can I do something for you?'
